family: RSI divergence gated by Malkan regime
title: Rerun, run 1: RSI divergence entries only when monthly AND weekly RSI agree with the daily SMA200 side (15m, 1h, 4h, 1d), DEV 2022-2024

what.name: Rule
what.value_plain: Malkan gate as written: monthly AND weekly RSI >= 60 bull / <= 40 bear, daily SMA200 side; bullish/bearish swing divergence signal, signal or retest entry, exit 10 bars
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Windows and entry arms
what.value_plain: divergence windows 3-10, 5-14, W12, W18; retest N=10 at the swing B close; these are variants of the study
what.label: OURS

what.name: Regime mix
what.value_plain: 130 weeks DEV: bull 25 (19%) | bear 0 (0%) | range 105 (81%) | n/a 0 (0%)
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Power gate
what.value_plain: prereg_gate BLOCK on all four TFs (BLOCKED.md): the 1 / 18 / 43 / 164 aligned bullish setups (1d / 4h / 1h / 15m) cannot detect a plausible effect
what.label: OURS

what.name: Survivor rule
what.value_plain: n >= 30, >= 20 days, net > 0, Holm p < 0.05, excess t >= 2
what.label: OURS

how: Event study on BTCUSDT 1m aggregated per TF; the gate removes 83 % of 15m events; day-clustered 95 % CI on fee-net return; 256 cells in dev_cells.csv (gate x TF x arm x kind x entry), 32 confirmatory.
window: DEV 2022-01-01..2024-06-30 BTCUSDT futures 1m; VALIDATION not read (no DEV survivor); HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL and not PASS: 0 of 32 confirmatory cells survived the DEV rule; the gate leaves bull in 25 of 130 weeks and never bear, so 0 bearish setups exist

why: 15m W12 bullish signal: ungated n 973 net -0.161 % [-0.229, -0.092]; aligned (bull regime) n 164 / 96 days, net -0.176 % [-0.307, -0.045], excess over bull drift -0.064 % (t -1.0): the gate did not make the signal positive.
1h aligned n 43 net +0.111 % [-0.394, +0.615], t 0.43; 4h n 18 net -0.736 %; 1d n 1. Every positive-looking cell has a CI spanning zero. No confirmatory cell has Holm p below 0.265.
Bearish aligned cells are empty (0 bear weeks); counter-regime and range bearish 15m net -0.176 % (n 208) and -0.179 % (n 810).
Next powered step needs more symbols or a longer history (monthly RSI from 2017), not another BTC DEV read. Not a PASS.
